components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            lives at the same address with the same last name (a shared household).
            Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. It starts at 1, gains a level when an email address is present and another when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city via the pinned city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners who live in the same household (same last name and address), assigned when an owner joins an existing household via 'sharesHousehold'. Null for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on this owner's registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: How the owner prefers to be contacted, 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'PHONE'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I consolidated the three separate duplicate checks (telephone, email, household) into a single derived `identityKey` and made an exact whole-key match the only 409 condition.

**The key** — `identityKey = normalizedTelephone + "|" + (email or empty) + "|" + householdId`, each segment canonicalized the way it's stored (E.164 phone, lower-cased email, shared household id; empty segments when absent).

**New code** (in `rest/function/owner`):
- `IdentityKeys` — the one place the key is derived. `of(Owner)` for stored owners; `of(OwnerFieldsDto, repo)` for the incoming request, which resolves the household id the owner *would* be assigned so a re-submitted household member still collides.
- `EnsureUniqueIdentity` — the single check step: builds the request's key and rejects only when it equals an existing owner's whole key.
- `DuplicateIdentityException` + `DuplicateIdentityExceptionHandler` + escalation YAML → 409.
- `Households.resolveHouseholdId(...)` — reuses the existing `matches`/`id` logic (mirrors `AssignHousehold`) so household resolution isn't duplicated.

**Wiring changes:**
- `owners.POST.yml` — replaced the `ensureUniqueTelephone → ensureUniqueEmail → ensureUniqueHousehold` chain with one `ensureUniqueIdentity` step, kept before `build`/`assignHousehold` so rejection happens before any mutation.
- `openapi.yml` — added the read-only `identityKey` property to the `Owner` schema (so it's returned).
- `OwnerMapper` — populates `identityKey` via `IdentityKeys.of(owner)` on every `OwnerDto`.

**Removed:** the three `EnsureUnique*` steps, their three `Duplicate*Exception` classes, three handlers, and three escalation YAMLs.

**Behaviour change, as specified:** because telephone is only one part of the key, two members of the same household with different telephones now have different keys and are both allowed — a same-telephone request is a duplicate only when its email and household id also match exactly. The acceptance test's collision case (same telephone, both no email, both non-shared → equal keys) correctly returns 409.
